name: Draft Room
start: bash -lc 'SESSION=draft-room-dev; ROOT="${PWD:-/workspace}"; CONF=/exec-daemon/tmux.portal.conf; TMUX_BIN=$(command -v tmux 2>/dev/null || true); [ -x /exec-daemon/tmux ] && TMUX_BIN=/exec-daemon/tmux; if [ -n "$TMUX_BIN" ] && [ -f "$CONF" ]; then "$TMUX_BIN" -f "$CONF" has-session -t "=$SESSION" 2>/dev/null || "$TMUX_BIN" -f "$CONF" new-session -d -s "$SESSION" -c "$ROOT" -- bash "$ROOT/scripts/keep-dev-server.sh"; else bash "$ROOT/scripts/keep-dev-server.sh"; fi'
